category: hosted managed database service for MongoDB, Redis, MySQL and PostgreSQL

free_tier.stated: No free plan. A 7-day free trial of the fully managed DBaaS platform is available with no credit card; signup asks for an email and a new password. Trial Dedicated Hosting is limited to one Micro-sized standalone instance per database type. If no payment method is entered by the end of the 7 days, the cluster is automatically deleted.
free_tier.notes: The 7-day trial is time-limited and ends in deletion of the cluster unless a payment method is added. There is no recurring free allowance.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap is published on the pages read. The trial Dedicated Hosting limit is one Micro-sized standalone instance per database type.

retention.stated: If a payment method has not been entered by the end of the free 7-day trial period, the cluster is automatically deleted. Paid Dedicated Hosting includes up to 5 free backups per deployment, with additional backups for a fee.

egress.terms: Dedicated Hosting and Shared Hosting plans include all data transfer costs; Bring Your Own Cloud plans use the standard transfer rights of the connected cloud provider.

interface_detail: a web management console and a documented API; clusters speak the native wire protocol of the selected database engine
tooling: the native client for the chosen engine (mongosh, redis-cli, mysql, psql); the ScaleGrid Console and its API
chaining: a managed cluster hosted on AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, Linode or DigitalOcean on Dedicated Hosting, or in the reader's own cloud account on Bring Your Own Cloud

limits.value: cluster automatically deleted at the end of the 7-day trial if a payment method has not been entered
one Micro-sized standalone instance per database type during the Dedicated Hosting trial; clone, Peek at Backup and Scaling are not supported in the trial

binding_note: the 7-day trial clock deletes the cluster unless a payment method is added, so the retention limit fails before the one-instance-per-type quota or any paid price

identity_cost.detail: signup asks for an email and a new password with no credit card required; the Getting Started page specifies a business email. All accounts start as a trial and require a payment method only to continue after the 7 days. No phone number or identity document is shown.

reliability_note: the trial ends in automatic deletion of the cluster if no payment method is entered; Shared Hosting is no longer supported for new customer signups
confidence_note: four first-party pages were captured and quoted on 2026-11-19: the trial limitations page, the Getting Started page, the pricing FAQ and the Dedicated Hosting plans page. The trial terms, signup fields and price come from those pages. No probe was run, so the rung stays documented.

evidence.quote: At ScaleGrid, we provide a [free 7-day trial](https://console.scalegrid.io/users/register) so you can explore all the features in our fully managed DBaaS plans to decide whether our platform is right for you. No credit card required to sign up, simply enter your email and a new password to get access to your own personal database management and monitoring console.
evidence.proved: a 7-day free trial with no card; signup asks for an email and a new password

evidence.quote: 1. During the trial period, you are limited to one Micro-sized standalone instance per database type.
evidence.proved: the Dedicated Hosting trial is limited to one Micro standalone instance per database type

evidence.quote: 1. If a payment method has not been entered by the end of your free 7-day trial period, your cluster will be automatically deleted.
evidence.proved: the cluster is deleted at the end of the 7-day trial without a payment method

evidence.quote: Just enter a business email and a password, no credit card required.
evidence.proved: signup asks for a business email and a password with no card

evidence.quote: You bet! Try any of our plans free through our 7-day free trial, no credit card required.
evidence.proved: the 7-day free trial requires no credit card

evidence.quote: > 🚧 Shared Hosting is no longer supported for new customer signups.
evidence.proved: Shared Hosting is closed to new signups
the cheapest dedicated PostgreSQL plan starts at USD 13 per month

notes: ScaleGrid is a hosted managed database service, not software the reader runs. Its only no-cost path is a 7-day trial that deletes the cluster unless a payment method is added. The cheapest paid dedicated PostgreSQL plan is USD 13 per month. Shared Hosting, once a low-cost tier, is closed to new signups.
